name: Pylon
description: A B2B support and helpdesk platform that unifies customer communication across Slack, email, and other channels with deep CRM integrations.

evidence.claim: The Pylon API uses Bearer authentication with an API token.
Only Admin users can create API tokens.
The API covers a broad range of objects including accounts, issues, messages, knowledge base, custom objects, and more.
Webhooks are supported and can be configured via triggers in the settings.
The platform requires booking a demo for access, indicating a sales-led or contact-based signup process.

notes: Pylon uses region-specific API base URLs (US and EU). API tokens can only be generated by Admin users within the Pylon dashboard.
